notes.title: SEEK OR DIE V.2.0 OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
Yep, Seek Or Die V.2.0 is RELEASED!

Hey everyone!

I know I usually don't meet my deadlines, but hey, there's a first time for everything.

Seek Or Die V.2.0 is a major update to the game. It addresses many bugs and problems V.1.3 had. 

If you want to play V.1.3 again (for some reason) I kept an open branch that can be accessed through the "Betas" tab of the Properties menu for my game.

Seek Or Die V.2.0 Includes:
- A REAL monster
- A story-line
- Multiple endings
- Multiple objectives 
- Additive distractions that make Part I more difficult
- Little bits and bobs to make the game run smoother
- A donate button (my favorite feature)

Thank you all for supporting me as I develop this game. The amount of community support has been overwhelming and I never expected to get this far. So thank you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png

-Flashynurav

notes.title: Vote Now! Should I Change the Map?
notes.content:
This is VERY important, so please take some time to read.

So someone commented under my update post that I should consider changing the map of the house because it is a demo package and not hand-created. I do recognize that this seems lazy, HOWEVER: it is in no way wrong/illegal. The mansion layout was part of a bigger package and I am free to use it as I see fit. 

Still, it matters what you guys think more than what I think. If you believe I should create my own map, I will gladly do so. This DOES mean that the update will need to be pushed another month. 

Tell me what you think in the comments, should I make my own map or no?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png

-Flashynurav

notes.title: ITS ALMOST HERE!!!
notes.content:
Hey there everybody!

I have a CONFIRMED release date for "Seek Or Die V.2.0". 
It will be released next Saturday, 6/16/18, at 7:00 PM PDT. Get ready!

I also wanted to take this time to say how grateful I am to all of you who have checked out my game. For an indie developer (I can call myself that now) and his first game I am blown away with the amount of attention and support I received. Thank you. :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png
